temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study states sampling was carried out between September and November 2013.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes insecticide resistance in Aedes aegypti from Madeira Island, Portugal. It reports resistance to multiple insecticide classes, metabolic resistance mechanisms, and the presence of kdr mutations V1016I and F1534C. The paper is ineligible because it studies Aedes aegypti, not Anopheles.
exclusion_reasons: is_anopheles: The paper studies Aedes aegypti, not Anopheles.
